basic_details.job_title: Civil Court, Sheikhpura Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Stenographer, Clerk and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Three contractual posts in the Evening Court, Civil Court, Sheikhpura – one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly – are open only to retired Civil Court employees. Under Advertisement Notice No.01/2026 of the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Sheikhpura, applications with the listed documents must reach that office by registered post or in person latest by 21 December 2026, till 05:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: About Sheikhpura Civil Court Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Sheikhpura, and is signed by Santosh Kumar Tiwary, Principal District and Sessions Judge, Sheikhpura, on 21-11-2026. It engages dedicated supportive staff for the evening Court of Sheikhpura Judgeship, which functions within the Civil Court, Sheikhpura.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application, along with the applicant's willingness and all the documents listed under Enclosures, must reach the following office: Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Sheikhpura Mode: through registered post or personally (by hand). Deadline: the application must reach the office latest by 21 December 2026, till 05:00 PM. This is a date of receipt, not of dispatch. Application form: the notice does not print an application form or a format; it asks for the application with the applicant's willingness and the enclosures. The notice does not mention any text to be written on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice prints no salary amount. It states that the period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. The applicant must be a retired Civil Court employee. Only those retired Civil Court employees who have retired within the preceding three years, prior to the period when the selection is being made for such evening courts, or as per the guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court of Judicature at Patna and Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post. The applicant must possess satisfactory service records. The service-record condition excludes a retired employee: who is facing any vigilance case; against whom any departmental proceedings are pending; against whom any serious charges are pending; against whom any criminal case of any kind is registered; against whom any major punishment has been awarded during the service period. The applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing in Hindi or English, as the case may be. The applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical work done in Civil Court of both posts, i.e. Office Clerk and Bench Clerk. The applicant must be capable of performing the duties attached to the post and must have experience of working as Office Attendant and Orderly. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification or an age limit for any of the three posts. Candidates should check the official notification for the post-specific eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Sheikhpura Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly in the Evening Court, Civil Court, Sheikhpura.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Sheikhpura latest by 21 December 2026, till 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for these Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: Only retired Civil Court employees who retired within the preceding three years, or as per the guidelines of the Hon'ble High Court of Judicature at Patna and Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India, can apply. They must be physically and mentally fit and have satisfactory service records.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is required for the Stenographer post?
faq.answer: The applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing in Hindi or English, as the case may be.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The notice prints no amount; remuneration shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for Sheikhpura Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the application with your willingness and the listed documents to the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Sheikhpura through registered post or submit it personally, so that it reaches by 21 December 2026, 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: A copy of the Pension Payment Order, a copy of the Aadhar Card, a copy of the PAN Card and an undertaking regarding details of departmental proceeding pending/disposal, if any.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual, can be terminated at any time for non-satisfactory performance, and does not confer any right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q9. How many hours a day must the selected staff work?
faq.answer: Selected candidates must perform their duties for a minimum period of 05 hours on each working day, as prescribed for the evening court.

faq.question: Q10. Who cannot apply even if retired from the Civil Court?
faq.answer: A retired employee facing a vigilance case, with departmental proceedings or serious charges pending, with any criminal case registered, or awarded a major punishment during service is excluded by the service-record condition.
